# Karpathy

Andrej Karpathy. The talks/posts I keep coming back to:

- "Software 2.0" — frame for thinking about LLM-powered systems as
  programmable with data, not just code.
- "Intro to LLMs" — the friendliest end-to-end primer.

His framing of evals as "you can't improve what you can't measure" is the
mental model behind [[Evals]] and the whole [[Eval harness]] design.
